changelog: Fixes AnimeThemes HTTP 403 requests and provider fallthrough, reuses Trailer Reel's yt-dlp when available for curated YouTube themes, and suppresses repeated outage warnings.
description: Finds missing TV series themes through ThemerrDB, strictly matched AnimeThemes openings, and Plex, then saves normalized theme.mp3 files without overwriting existing themes.
name: Theme Music Finder
overview: Finds missing TV series theme music and saves it as theme.mp3.
